title: The Mystery
description: Researchers found a sealed machine in an abandoned laboratory. Whenever they enter some information, it produces an output, but nobody knows how it works. Study the recorded examples, discover the hidden rule, and reproduce the machine's output for any input.
input_format:
The first line contains an integer N.
The second line contains N space-separated integers.
output_format: Print a single integer representing the value produced by the hidden machine.
